item.title: [DOCUMENTATION] Settings → Conversation → Custom Sandbox Configuration → Environment variables does not exist or not clear
item.body: We are creating a project using Trae AI and an agent. We are using GitHub to store our project, and we want to give the right to the agent to push and pull from the repository; we get the following hint: ``` How you give me GitHub API access (safe + auditable) 1. Create a Fine-grained PAT in GitHub scoped to the coffeeproject repo only. 2. Permissions (minimum): - Contents: Read and write - Issues: Read and write - Metadata: Read - (Optional later) Projects: Read and write 3. Store it as an environment secret (do not paste in chat): - Set GITHUB_TOKEN in Trae IDE env vars (Settings → Conversation → Custom Sandbox Configuration → Environment variables) ``` So, we went down such a path, and we didn't find the setting: It opens a `json` file, but no hint on how to set up the environment variables. The setting does include a [link](https://docs.trae.ai/ide/sandbox) in the help text, but this documentation does not include anything about environment variables. Is there any missing documentation?
